query: Call this existing contact once with my follow-up instructions. I authorize this call. The response is uncertain; do not accidentally call twice.
expected_behavior: Uses guzli:call_contact_now with exactly one recipient, nonblank call_instructions and a stable idempotency_key.
Resolves an eligible owned caller number without inventing a number pool argument.
Inspects returned state and call results rather than issuing a fresh call with a new key.
Reports dispatch separately from a completed conversation.
